mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, the temperature is 44 degrees with clear skies observed at Harriet Park and the moon in its third quarter phase.

Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to honor the expertise of our Planning and Development Department. Also, please note that a section of Highway M will be closed for construction from October 6 through October 9.
You can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, local trivia options include Hop Haus Brewing, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.
In a notable incident on September 21, a retail theft occurred at a business in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue where a subject stole Swedish Fish candy and was later identified and cited.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
